description: SpacePy is an open-source Python package for the space sciences that makes data access, analysis, empirical modelling and visualisation easier: it reads NASA CDF and other space physics formats, fetches and interpolates OMNI solar wind and geomagnetic index data, transforms between space coordinate systems, runs common empirical models such as magnetic field and radiation belt models, and produces publication-quality plots. It was started at Los Alamos National Laboratory and is maintained by the SpacePy team to replace proprietary tools and support reproducible research. Coverage is global near-Earth space; resolution follows the input datasets. Format and access: pip install spacepy, with a full manual on the documentation site; version 0.7.0 of November 2024 was read. Licence: Python Software Foundation licence per the PyPI classifiers, copyright Triad National Security; free. Caveats: the package is marked Beta, some models need compiled extensions, and it is a science toolkit, not an infrastructure model. It prepares solar wind, index and field inputs for space weather hazard exposure and grid resilience studies. Related catalogue records are NASA OMNIWeb, a common input it reads, and the Space Weather Modeling Framework.
